item.name: Amazon Redshift - G E T_ Modify Cluster Subnet Group

request.name: Amazon Redshift - G E T_ Modify Cluster Subnet Group

description.content: Modifies a cluster subnet group to include the specified list of VPC subnets. The operation replaces the existing list of subnets with the new list of subnets.

query.description: (Required) The name of the subnet group to be modified.
A text description of the subnet group to be modified.
(Required) An array of VPC subnet IDs. A maximum of 20 subnets can be modified in a single request.
(Required) An array of VPC subnet IDs. A maximum of 20 subnets can be modified in a single request.
